title: Senior Scientist, Protein Engineering and Novel Modalities, Biologics Engineering, Oncology R&D

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our team. [Company name masked] Biologics Engineering is responsible for the discovery, design, engineering, and optimization of next-generation biologics to create biological drug candidates for all key therapeutic areas.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Accountabilities:
As a Senior Scientist, you will lead collaborative workstreams with a diverse group of scientists across all therapeutic areas to ensure timely progress in research projects and drive technological innovations. You will conceive, design, and execute the engineering of innovative multispecific antibodies with improved selectivity and developability. Your role will also involve the biochemical, biophysical, and functional characterization of antibodies and multispecific modalities. You will also prepare, analyze, and present data internally and externally.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD + 0-3 years' of experience in Chemical or Biological Engineering, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry or other relevant scientific field with experience in protein engineering and/or bispecific antibody technologies
Extensive hands-on experience in molecular biology and antibody/protein engineering
Comprehensive experience in tissue culture techniques and functional cell-based assay development
Understanding of protein and antibody structure-function relationships
Proven ability to work independently, effectively plan and organize work activities and prioritize task completion to meet project deadlines
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and effective presentation of complex scientific data to cross-functional and senior management
Preferred Requirements
Deep understanding of various imaging/multicolor flow cytometry-based instruments and data analysis programs
Demonstrated experience in optimizing/troubleshooting protocols with a problem-solving mindset
Experience in engineering antibodies with improved properties (e.g., affinity, solubility, and other attributes related to developability)
Experience with bispecific therapeutics, e.g. T-cell engagers, ADCs, checkpoint inhibitors
Background in antibody discovery using one of several display-based technologies

A central part of this role is staying in regular contact with scientists across therapeutic areas to move research projects forward and contribute to platform technology development.
cond_0258.responsibilities: As a Senior Scientist, you will actively lead collaborative workstreams with a diverse group of scientists across all therapeutic areas, regularly communicating to ensure timely progress in research projects and contribute to technological innovations. You will conceive, design, and execute the engineering of innovative multispecific antibodies with improved selectivity and developability. Your role will also involve the biochemical, biophysical, and functional characterization of antibodies and multispecific modalities. You will prepare, analyze, and present data, both internally and externally, walking colleagues and stakeholders through findings and handling questions on complex scientific topics.
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD with 0–3 years of experience in Chemical or Biological Engineering, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field, with experience in protein engineering and/or bispecific antibody technologies
Extensive hands-on experience in molecular biology and antibody/protein engineering
Comprehensive experience in tissue culture techniques and functional cell-based assay development
Deep understanding of various imaging/multicolor flow cytometry-based instruments and data analysis programs
Understanding of protein and antibody structure-function relationships
Ability to work independently, plan and organize work activities, and prioritize tasks to meet project deadlines
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear presentation of complex scientific data to cross-functional teams and senior management
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated experience in optimizing and troubleshooting protocols with a problem-solving mindset
Experience in engineering antibodies with improved properties (e.g., affinity, solubility, and other developability attributes)
Experience with bispecific therapeutics, such as T-cell engagers, ADCs, or checkpoint inhibitors
Background in antibody discovery using display-based technologies

cond_0523.intro: We are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our team. [Company name masked] Biologics Engineering is responsible for the discovery, design, engineering, and optimization of next-generation biologics to create biological drug candidates for all key therapeutic areas.
cond_0523.responsibilities:
Accountabilities:
As a Senior Scientist, you will lead collaborative workstreams with a diverse group of scientists across all therapeutic areas to ensure timely progress in research projects and drive technological innovations. You will conceive, design, and execute the engineering of innovative multispecific antibodies with improved selectivity and developability. Your role will also involve the biochemical, biophysical, and functional characterization of antibodies and multispecific modalities. You will also prepare, analyze, and present data internally and externally.
cond_0523.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD + 0-3 years' of experience in Chemical or Biological Engineering, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry or other relevant scientific field with experience in protein engineering and/or bispecific antibody technologies
Extensive hands-on experience in molecular biology and antibody/protein engineering
Comprehensive experience in tissue culture techniques and functional cell-based assay development
Understanding of protein and antibody structure-function relationships
Proven ability to work independently, effectively plan and organize work activities and prioritize task completion to meet project deadlines
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and effective presentation of complex scientific data to cross-functional and senior management
Preferred Requirements
Deep understanding of various imaging/multicolor flow cytometry-based instruments and data analysis programs
Demonstrated experience in optimizing/troubleshooting protocols with a problem-solving mindset
Experience in engineering antibodies with improved properties (e.g., affinity, solubility, and other attributes related to developability)
Experience with bispecific therapeutics, e.g. T-cell engagers, ADCs, checkpoint inhibitors
Background in antibody discovery using one of several display-based technologies
